requests.message: Hello Tobi. Corinne from Greaveholme Town. I have seen you three times this season. I know you finish your degree in the summer and I would like to talk, with your club's agreement, about what you want to do after that. No rush and no obligation.

requests.club_consent_note: Happy for Reuben to have the conversation. He has only been with us two months — please keep me copied on anything about a trial.
requests.message: Hello Reuben. I am the recruitment lead at Greaveholme Town. I was at the Skerraby game and I have watched it back since. The way you receive on the half-turn is not common at this level. I am not offering anything today. I would like to introduce myself, hear how you came to Quillmere, and ask whether you would be open to us watching you a couple more times this autumn. Your manager knows I am writing.
Hello Seren. Corinne from Greaveholme Town. Our women's first team is looking for a centre-back and your name came up. Would you be open to a conversation?

latest_outcome.notes: Reserves manager already has cover in that role. Told the player directly and pointed him towards Quillmere's open trial.

requests.message: Hello Antoni. Corinne from Greaveholme Town. I have let Hallowfen know I am getting in touch. I saw on your profile that you are looking for first-team football. Come and train with our reserves and we will both find out whether it is a fit.
Hello Jermaine. Corinne from Greaveholme Town. I see you are back in Wendleshire and between clubs. Our reserves need a centre-forward. Would you like to come and train?
Hello Kofi. Corinne from Greaveholme Town. You are the best one-against-one defender I have seen in this league. Would you be open to a conversation about stepping up?

requests.club_consent_note: Yes. He is ready to be looked at. Speak to Sunil about dates so it does not clash with an under-21 fixture.

latest_outcome.notes: Evening session with the development group. Father attending. Feedback to Quillmere's manager the next morning.

requests.message: Hello Nabil. I am Corinne, recruitment lead at Greaveholme Town. I have watched you twice for the under-21s. I would like to invite you to train with our development group for an evening, with Quillmere's blessing. Would you be open to that?
